summary: Apple documents makeBuffer(bytesNoCopy:length:options:deallocator:) as wrapping an existing contiguous allocation, requiring a page-aligned pointer and a length that results in a page-aligned region, and returning nil on failure.

facts.text: Apple documents makeBuffer(bytesNoCopy:length:options:deallocator:) as wrapping an existing contiguous allocation, requiring a page-aligned pointer and a length that results in a page-aligned region, and returning nil on failure.
The deallocator block runs when the buffer is deallocated so the caller can release the underlying memory, or nil opts out.
MLX's own allocator wraps external memory through make_buffer with device newBuffer(ptr, size, options, nullptr), a nil deallocator, shared storage mode, and adds the buffer to the residency set.

A residency-set entry for a NoCopy buffer asks the OS to keep the pages resident, but a read-only file-backed mapping can still be evicted before first use; the existing dossiers cover the refault evidence.
